provenance.artwork: Original project artwork generated with the built-in image generation tool; original prompt archived in art-prompt.txt.
provenance.source_motion: Static camera and terrain; localized horizontal water ripple, nearest sampling, sinusoidal 12-second phase.
provenance.endpoint_treatment: Blend the original decoded loop against its first frame with sin(PI*N/180)^2 motion weight; N is the 1-based blend frame number. Preserve matched endpoints using lossless H.264 yuv420p encoding.
provenance.amber_derivation: Constant colorchannelmixer and saturation/gamma grade of the endpoint-treated Moonlit Lake; reproduction command in README.md.

samples.title: Moonlit Lake
samples.description: Cool moonlit pixel landscape with localized periodic water ripples and matched loop endpoints.

samples.title: Amber Lake
samples.description: Constant warm dusk color grade of Moonlit Lake, retaining its localized water motion and matched loop endpoints.
